author: Mooch24
body:
I think CherrylandMC could play better with more TNT in more locations. Currently, there are 2 stacks located directly in front of spawn. Most of the time they're grabbed instantly by 1 or 2 people.

I think there should be 2 single chests filled with TNT on the left and right side of the map. Possible near where the supplies are to make cannons?
